messages:
Ana (CS): quick heads-up — NovaWave onboarding shows a long tail on small requests (95th ~1.9s) while median is great. I want to propose a staged 'compact-mix' routing: short queries -> compact int8, long/complex queries -> fp16. early estimate: ~18% token cost savings, expected quality delta <5% on our intent set. can we run a canary?

Mike (Eng): can do. can you share the token-length distribution and a sample eval? also need fallback rules for when compact trips up.

Ana (CS): attaching a quick config sketch and the small eval set plan. will run 500 prompts across top intents, log intent accuracy + latency. config:```
routing:
  - match: { max_tokens: 60 }
    model: "redwood/compact-int8-v1"
    fallback: "redwood/base-fp16-v2"
  - match: { min_tokens: 61 }
    model: "redwood/base-fp16-v2"
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl_seconds: 600
metrics:
  tag: compactmix=true
  collect: [model, route, tokens, latency_ms, intent_confidence]
```

Jon (SRE): prefer staged rollout: 1) 0.5% traffic for 24h, 2) 3% for 48h, 3) 10% if stable. I'll wire alerts: 95p latency > 2s OR intent-accuracy drop > 2% triggers immediate rollback. We'll also tag logs with `compactmix` and route for easy query.

Mike (Eng): for observability add a lightweight payload diff sampler (1 in 200 requests record output from fp16 baseline for manual QA). also please include token-level timing so we can see if KV cache helps.

DeployBot: Canary job created: id=cmx-2026-03-20-1, target=NovaWave, initial-rate=0.5%, config-ref=routing/compactmix-v1. status=queued

Ana (CS): i'll schedule customer window Thu 10–11am PST and run the 500-prompt eval pre-canary. will post the run results in this thread. tagging @Mike (Eng) @Jon (SRE) for final sign-off :thumbsup:

Jon (SRE): acknowledged. i'll add the rollback playbook to the runbook and enable the alerts. will follow up with a short checklist (canary targets, log queries, dashboards).

Mike (Eng): signoff pending the eval metrics. if accuracy drop <=2% and 95p latency improves or stays equal, we go ahead.

Ana (CS): great — expect eval link and numbers in ~4h: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/compactmix-eval (internal)
